# Reference implementation build inputs

This directory contains the readable source from which supplied reference
modules will be built. It is intentionally separate from the student-facing
`ucsb_xrp` package and from generated `.mpy` artifacts.

The source is retained so that physical and browser artifacts can be generated
from one reviewed implementation and tested against the same public behavior.
Generated bytecode must not be edited by hand. The present Challenge 1 source
was compiled twice with the pinned MicroPython 1.28.0 `mpy-cross`; identical
artifacts passed the same public behavior vector in browser MicroPython and on
the RP2350. That verifies packaging and current behavior, not that this first
algorithm is definitive. The implementation remains open to coordinated
improvement when course or student evidence supports it.
